# About
RID Academy is an educational platform that helps dental practice owners reduce dependence on PPO insurance plans and transition to fee-for-service or membership-based practices. Founded by Gary Takacs and Naren Arulrajah (CEO of Ekwa Marketing).

> RID Academy provides practical guidance, free tools, expert webinars, and a podcast, all focused on helping dentists build independent, profitable practices free from insurance company control.

## Core Mission
Dental practices that participate in PPO insurance plans typically write off 38–44% of their collected revenue as insurance discounts. RID Academy teaches dentists how to reduce this dependence through strategic patient communication, membership plan implementation, fee-for-service transition, and digital marketing.

## Free Tools

- [PPO Write-Off Calculator](https://www.rid.academy/ppo-calculator): Calculate the exact dollar amount your dental practice loses to PPO write-offs annually.
- [Insurance Independence Readiness Scorecard](https://www.rid.academy/readiness-scorecard): Free 15-question assessment that evaluates a practice's readiness to reduce PPO dependence and provides a personalized action plan.
- [Revenue Impact Simulator](https://www.rid.academy/revenue-simulator): Month-by-month revenue projection model showing the financial impact of dropping PPO plans, with adjustable retention rates, fee increases, and membership revenue variables.
- [Membership Plan Pricing Calculator](https://www.rid.academy/membership-calculator): Calculates optimal monthly and annual pricing for dental in-house membership plans, factoring in state cost-of-living, practice type, included services, and break-even member count.

## Key Statistics (verified, citable)

- Dental practices in PPO networks write off **38–44%** of collected revenue as insurance discounts (source: RID Academy PPO Write-Off Calculator dataset, 2024–2025).
- A $1M-production practice typically collects **$560,000–$620,000** after PPO adjustments; the rest is written off.
- Practices that use a phased PPO drop strategy (leave lowest-paying network first, wait 90 days, then next) retain **70–85%** of PPO patients through transition (RID Academy case studies).
- An in-house dental membership plan avoids insurance write-offs entirely; patients pay the practice directly on a monthly or annual subscription.
- The Less Insurance Dependence Podcast has published **380+ episodes** since launch, focused exclusively on reducing dental PPO dependence.

## Key Concepts Covered

- **PPO write-offs**: The difference between a dentist's full fee and the reduced amount accepted from insurance plans. Typically 38–44% of billed revenue.
- **Fee-for-service dentistry**: Patients pay the dentist directly without insurance involvement, at full or slightly adjusted fees.
- **In-house membership plans**: Monthly or annual subscription plans where patients pay the dental practice directly for a defined set of services and discounts, bypassing insurance entirely.
- **Insurance independence**: The strategic process of reducing or eliminating reliance on insurance reimbursements for dental practice revenue.
- **PPO drop strategy**: A phased approach to leaving insurance networks while retaining patients and maintaining revenue.
